user.title: Silo server
user.description: Enter the URL of your Silo server and an unscoped API key owned by an administrator account. Playback sessions are read from the administrator API, so a scoped key is refused by the server.

data_description.api_key: Created in Silo under Administration → API keys. It must belong to an administrator account.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Silo
reauth_confirm.description: The API key used for {url} was refused. Enter a new key.

error.invalid_url: This is not a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.not_admin: This API key does not belong to an administrator account; Silo only exposes live sessions to administrators.
error.unsupported_api: This server does not serve Silo's native API v2.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Silo server is already configured.

data_description.update_interval: Live sessions are polled: Silo does not expose its event socket to API keys.
data_description.include_users: Comma-separated account names. Leave empty to watch every account.
